# The Mediterranean Dish

> A comprehensive Mediterranean lifestyle and culinary resource offering authentic recipes, diet guidance, curated ingredients, and immersive culinary experiences.

The Mediterranean Dish is founded by Suzy Karadsheh, a New York Times bestselling author, and serves as both an educational platform for Mediterranean diet and cuisine and a marketplace for premium Mediterranean ingredients and spices. The site combines recipe content, nutrition guidance, and experiential offerings including culinary tours.

## Key Topics

- Mediterranean Diet
- Mediterranean Recipes
- Suzy Karadsheh
- Mediterranean Cuisine
- Healthy Eating
- Italian Cooking
- Greek Cooking
- Extra Virgin Olive Oil (EVOO)
- Gourmet Spices
- Meal Planning
- Vegetarian Meals
- Middle Eastern Flavors
- Specialty Foods
- NYT Bestselling Author
- Culinary Travel
